Flexibility: 5

It also includes hybrid human-AI models and offline modes, showing adaptability to varying levels of tech adoption and infrastructure.

Elaboration: 5

It also includes gender-specific considerations (e.g., guardian mode in Saudi Arabia) and local language/UI adaptations, ensuring appropriateness across all target regions.
